title.rendered: Container Offices for Sale in Frazer Town

content.rendered:
If you are looking for container offices for sale in Frazer Town, SAMAN Portable builds them to order at our Bengaluru factory in Gopasandra 560099 and delivers them ready to use across the city. As the manufacturer, we fabricate each container office on an MS steel frame, fit it out to your layout, and dispatch it to your Frazer Town site, so you deal directly with the people who make the unit rather than a reseller.

Container Offices for Sale in Frazer Town

A container office is a factory-built steel cabin sized like a shipping container, finished inside with flooring, wiring, lighting, windows and a door so it works as a ready office. SAMAN Portable manufactures 10ft, 20ft and 40ft container offices at its Bengaluru unit and delivers them to Frazer Town, giving local businesses a durable, movable workspace without a long construction project.

Container office sizes we supply

We supply three standard sizes, each built on a welded MS steel frame and customisable in layout. Use the table below as a starting point and tell us your seating and equipment needs so we can recommend the right unit.

SizeTypical useApprox. seating
10ft container officeSite office, security or supervisor cabin, single workstation1–2 people
20ft container officeProject office, sales office, small team room3–5 people
40ft container officeLarger office, partitioned cabin with washroom or pantry6–10 people

All sizes can include partitions, extra windows, electrical points, insulation and a washroom. Two or more units can be placed side by side or stacked for a bigger floor area. Share your requirement for current pricing.

Why buy your container office direct from SAMAN

Buying direct from the manufacturer means the specification you approve is the specification we build. Every unit is made to clear standards and backed by real after-sales support.

  • MS steel frame to IS 2062: the structure is fabricated from mild steel sections to the IS 2062 standard for strength and a long working life.
  • Factory-built in Bengaluru: manufactured at our Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 unit under an ISO 9001:2015 quality system.
  • Warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life.
  • Delivery and returns: delivery from ₹3,000 with transit of 3–5 days, and returns accepted within 7 days of delivery or installation.

Delivery and installation in Frazer Town

We deliver and place container offices across Bengaluru, including Frazer Town and the surrounding east and central areas. Once your unit is built, it is loaded at our Bengaluru factory and transported to your site, where our team positions and levels it. Most sites need only a firm, level surface; tell us about gate width, access road and crane or hydra requirement at the enquiry stage so we plan the drop correctly. Typical transit after dispatch is 3–5 days.

Get a container office quote in Frazer Town

Tell us the size, internal layout and the date you need the unit on site, and we will prepare a quote for your Frazer Town location. To discuss your requirement or place an order, Call +91 62009 09435 or use Send Enquiry on our website. For the full range and current pricing, see our container office range.

FAQs


What sizes of container office can I buy in Frazer Town?

We supply 10ft, 20ft and 40ft container offices, and units can be combined side by side or stacked for more space. Each size is customisable in layout, windows, partitions and electricals.


How long does delivery to Frazer Town take?

Once your unit is manufactured and dispatched from our Bengaluru factory, transit is usually 3–5 days. Total time depends on the size and customisation you choose, which we confirm when you enquire.


Can the container office be customised for my business?

Yes. We add partitions, extra windows, electrical points, insulation, a pantry or a washroom, and finish the interior to suit a site office, sales office or team workspace.


What warranty comes with a SAMAN container office?

Every unit carries 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The frame is built on an MS steel structure to IS 2062.


How much does delivery cost?

Delivery starts from ₹3,000, with the final figure depending on unit size and site access. For unit pricing, share your requirement and we will send a current quote.


How do I order a container office in Frazer Town?

Call +91 62009 09435 or use Send Enquiry with your size, layout and required date. We confirm the specification, share a quote, then manufacture and deliver to your Frazer Town site.

author.description: Aman Dubey is the lead marketing and copywriting expert at Saman Portable, specializing in prefabricated, shipping-container, and modular structures. With over 15 years of industry experience, Aman has helped global clients optimize design, streamline production, and amplify brand visibility through data-driven content and strategic SEO. Under his guidance, Saman Portable has become a trusted name in container office solutions and turnkey prefabricated buildings across India and beyond.
